note: Story item id -> Gothic II NotR item instance. The tankards use mission items that never appear in Jarkendar (vanilla silver/gold cups lie all over the camp and must not count as Greg's tankard). ai_names are the neutral handles the AI sees (it never sees internal ids); descriptions are shown to the AI; game_names/game_texts replace the item's in-game name and description.
